# Agent Journal (structured notes)

## Findings
- TASK.md bug = matplotlib #23299. Repo: work/matplotlib-23299-panel @ 3eadeacc06 (HEAD is ancestor of fix commit 11a4071026 = PR #23299, present in object store).
- Root cause chain (read from code): rc_context saves/restores rcParams incl. 'backend'; if pyplot first used inside rc_context, rcParams['backend'] is restored to _auto_backend_sentinel; later get_backend() -> RcParams.__getitem__ sees sentinel -> plt.switch_backend(sentinel) -> close("all") -> Gcf.figs emptied.
- Fix (upstream 11a4071026): in rc_context, `orig = dict(rcParams.copy()); del orig['backend']` + docstring line "The :rc:`backend` will not be reset by the context manager."
- Diff panel vs built nopanel twin (same commit) = exactly the inverse of upstream fix => injected regression confirmed.
- Venv .pth wires matplotlib to matplotlib-20488-nopanel repo; must run with PYTHONPATH=<this repo>/lib. Panel repo had no .so/_version.py (gitignored build artifacts) — copied from nopanel twin (same commit, same py312) to make it importable.
